Inside each _run_request_sites() call, _verdict's parameter-provenance branch re-walks the entire src/rebar tree and re-parses every file multiple times per site, causing ~8,033 parses in a single scan where far fewer files exist
_functions() and _verdict's caller scan each independently re-parse the entire src/rebar tree, compounding the inner repetition layer
